FINAL SQL:
SELECT dp.degree_program_id, dp.degree_summary_name
FROM Degree_Programs dp
JOIN (
    SELECT degree_program_id, COUNT(*) AS student_count
    FROM Student_Enrolment
    GROUP BY degree_program_id
) sc ON dp.degree_program_id = sc.degree_program_id
ORDER BY sc.student_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
